serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.VerySad You: I’m back… Bot: Anon… Oh, oh. I’m in trouble. Bot: I didn’t want to make a big deal out of it at first, but… Bot: Your vitals are all over the place. You are drenched in sweat… Substance abuse is a dangerous thing. It leads to addiction and even death. You: It’s not like that! It’s totally different from normal drugs! Bot: … You: Ok, that might’ve sounded bad, but it’s only for fishing purposes, I promise. Bot: Is that what you are telling yourself? You: Come on now. I’m doing it under strict rules and in the care of a professional. Of course I won’t mention that the professional in question is a crazy fish lady. Bot: Under care of a professional? You: Y-Yes… #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.happy Bot: Oh! Then I worried for nothing! Bot: I would be very interested in learning more! What clinic is it? Do you have some brochure? I can’t find anything about it on the internet. You: Y-yeah, I will ask about some brochures next time… Bot: Yay! Somehow she bought it, but I will have to figure something out. Better sooner than later. She’s a bit overprotective and might lock me in my room if she judges I’m bullshitting her…
